Market: Change (Over Previous Month) = [Price - Price(Over Previous Month)/Price(Over Previous Month)] * 100
Market_Key: change (over previous month) = [price - price(over previous month)/price(over previous month)] * 100

Market: Change (Over Previous Year) = [Price - Price(Over Previous Year)/Price(Over Previous Year)] * 100
Market_Key: change (over previous year) = [price - price(over previous year)/price(over previous year)] * 100

Market_Key: weighted average price = ∑(arrival quantity * modal price) / ∑arrival quantity
